summary.text: Buddy DeLoach is a Republican state representative who has represented Georgia House District 167 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Nathaniel Hicks Jr.
A U.S. Army veteran, he owns an independent insurance agency.

paragraphs.text: DeLoach was born in Liberty County, Georgia, earned a degree from the University of Georgia, and served in the U.S. Army.
His career experience includes owning an independent insurance agency.

DeLoach defeated incumbent Jeff Jones in the June 9, 2020 Republican primary for House District 167 and then defeated Jerrold Dagen in the November 2020 general election, taking office on January 11, 2021.
He was re-elected in 2022 and defeated Rebekah Moore in the 2024 general election.

For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to nine committees, including the Reapportionment and Redistricting, Defense and Veterans Affairs, Judiciary, Natural Resources and Environment, Regulated Industries and Retirement committees, and he chairs the House Ethics Committee and is vice chair of the Insurance Committee.
